verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a business account product, but the evidence pack does not document opening multiple checking sub-accounts or automatically allocating incoming deposits across them. The multi-currency account supports holding balances in up to 56 currencies, which is a related but different feature: per-currency balances, not sub-accounts with deposit allocation rules.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
